message:
Hi love,

Happy monthsary(Kahit late na)! Alam mo, kahit madalas NATIN nakakalimutan tong araw na 'to, lagi akong napapaisip kung gaano ako kaswerte na ikaw ang kasama ko. Hindi ko talaga inakala nung una na you’d make such a big place in my heart. Pero ayun, nandito ka, making my days brighter, softer, and so much happier. 

Thank you for all the little things you do, yung mga bigay mo ng small letters, yung mga tawanan natin na minsan wala naman talagang sense, at yung presence mo na sapat na para gumaan ang araw ko. I treasure all of it lalab. Sobrang laki ng impact mo sa buhay ko, in a good way syempre. 

I want you to know that I’m proud of us. Proud ako sa growth natin, sa patience natin, and super duper proud ako sayo sa mga efforts mo na maging better for us.

Thank you for loving me in your own way, for understanding me even when I struggle to explain myself, and for staying kahit sa mga oras na mahirap. I promise to keep choosing you, to love you gently, and to be someone you can always feel safe and at home with.

More months with you, more memories, more laughter, 
more “tayo”.


I love you so much, happy monthsary my lalab. ❤️
